grades.quote: FMV.X.W moves the single-precision value in floating-point register _rs1_ represented in IEEE 754-2008 encoding to the lower 32 bits of integer register _rd_ . The bits are not modified in the transfer, and in particular, the payloads of non-canonical NaNs are preserved.
grades.reason: Describes RISC-V FMV.X.W and FMV.W.X, which move bit patterns unmodified between floating-point and integer registers in both directions. This answers the query directly.

grades.quote: `MOVFR2GR.D` writes the 64-bit value of the floating-point register `fj` into the general register `rd` .
grades.reason: Describes the LoongArch MOVFR2GR.{S/D} and MOVFRH2GR.S instructions. They copy FP register bits into a general register without conversion, but only in the FP-to-integer direction. MOVFR2GR.S also sign-extends the value.

Covers RISC-V D-extension numeric conversions (FCVT) and sign-injection. These change the value and round according to the rm field. They do not move raw bits between integer and FP registers, and the passage does not describe FMV.X.D or FMV.D.X.

grades.quote: `MOVGR2FR.D` writes the 64-bit value of general register `rj` into floating-point register `fd` .
grades.reason: Describes the LoongArch MOVGR2FR.{W/D} and MOVGR2FRH.W instructions. They copy general-register bits into a floating-point register without conversion, but only in the integer-to-FP direction.
